name: Web Search Demo
description: A 2-node demo workflow: an LLM node extracts the search goal from the user's question, then an expert node delegates to the web-researcher-search autonomous sub-expert which searches the web and returns a cited summary.

data.prompt:
The user asked the following question:

{{inputs.task}}

Analyze this question and determine the best web search strategy. Output a concise, specific search goal (1-2 sentences) describing what information to find on the web. Include any useful search keywords. Do not search yourself — just describe what should be searched.

Output ONLY the search goal text, no JSON, no markdown formatting.

data.subtaskPrompt:
Search the web for the following goal and return a cited summary:

{{extract-goal.output}}
